meta.title: File Tree Enhancements
meta.description: Add Git awareness to the workspace file tree: changed files are tinted with letter badges, folders aggregate their changes, and the files header shows the branch with its unpushed/unpulled commit counts. Right-clicking a file or folder adds a menu to attach it to the conversation, copy paths/links, preview in DSH, open a terminal, summarize or explain with AI, create/rename/delete entries, and reveal it in the file manager.
